summary: Data443 Risk Mitigation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $2M promissory note compensation agreement with Guangzhou Xiaoyu DiDa Technology (XYDD) upon termination of XYDD's prior business combination with Four Leaf Acquisition (FORL), allowing FORL to pursue a deal with Data443. The note is unsecured, payable in two $1M installments post-close, with 15% simple interest if late; convertible after 12 months at 80% of 20-day VWAP (floor 50% of post-close VWAP, cap 19.99% of shares). Watch for successful SPAC closure with Data443 and potential conversion dilution.
